GAIA Desktop @VERSION@

A desktop application for parsing and building GS1 Application Identifier data — type, paste, open or scan an input and read the result as a report.

Starting it

Java 21 or newer must be installed. This distribution is built for one operating system and processor, so use the one made for your machine.

  • Windows: double-click run.bat.
  • macOS: open GAIA Desktop.app (drag it to Applications first if you like), or run ./run.sh.
  • Linux: run ./run.sh.

Or from a terminal, beside gaia-desktop.jar and its lib/ folder:

java -jar gaia-desktop.jar
java -jar gaia-desktop.jar --language=FR

Guides

User Guide

Parsing, the builder, the report, options, languages, keyboard shortcuts and troubleshooting.

Zebra Scanner SetupWindows

Installing and configuring a Zebra scanner (tested with the DS8108): Java, the Zebra Scanner SDK, USB mode and GS1 settings, connecting, and troubleshooting.

Developer Guide

Building and packaging, architecture, the {GS} token, the scanner gate, localization, state file formats and testing.

The guides are Markdown files: they open as plain text in a browser, or formatted in any Markdown viewer. Links in the Developer Guide that point into the source tree (outside docs/) only work in a source checkout.
